result.one_liner: Notion is a workspace productivity platform that allows developers to programmatically access and manipulate databases, pages, blocks, and workspace content via API.

evidence.quote: The Notion API supports three bearer token types: internal integration tokens, OAuth access tokens from public connections, and personal access tokens (PATs)
OAuth 2.0 is for public integrations — intended to be installed by any Notion user across any workspace
The Notion API is available on the Free plan and access is included across all plans
Notion API enables developers to programmatically access and manipulate workspaces, databases, pages, and blocks
API documentation covers databases, pages, blocks, users, search, and comments

result.notes: Notion API is free to use across all workspace tiers with rate limits of ~3 requests/second. OAuth is required for public integrations, while internal integrations can use bearer tokens. All three workspace plans (Free, Plus, Business, Enterprise) have full API access.
